Open with the concrete situation the reader is in. One or two short paragraphs — no throat
clearing, no "in today's fast-moving landscape".

## The first section

Start at `##`; the `<h1>` comes from the frontmatter title. Keep paragraphs short — the measure is
about 46rem and long paragraphs read as walls on a phone.

### A subsection, if needed

`##` and `###` only. The table of contents ignores anything deeper, and it only appears at all
when the article has more than two headings.

## Tables and code

| Column | Column |
| ------ | ------ |
| Tables scroll horizontally on mobile automatically | No extra markup needed |

```bash
# Code blocks get dual-theme highlighting. Always tag the language.
npm run build
```

## Closing

End with something actionable. What should the reader do differently on Monday?
